recipes.name: Cardamom Avocado & Blueberry Smoothie
instructions: Add all ingredients to a high-speed blender and blend until smooth.
Pour the smoothie in tall glasses and top with desired garnish. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milks and yogurts that are fortified with calcium . † We used frozen wild blueberries, which we find gives a more vibrant purple colour once blended.
Storage Smoothies are best enjoyed immediately.
